method: Fresh independent visible UI review; exactly two ordinary-input terminal attempts at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ using tools/visible-playtest.mjs. No source, old reports, hidden state, debug URL, routes or arrangements inspected.

observations: Opening ADS burst killed induction guard with critical feedback, using the optic hint. Spent 12 rifle rounds.

Moved too far west into narrow space beside triage wall; south intake/east service hint was visible but did not immediately solve approach. Eventually moved around storage. Move closer prompt specified 0.7 m outside reach and floor ring; small lateral correction then held E successfully recovered Mara, reserve increased 180 to 240.
Recovered Sera after overshooting console and correcting backward/laterally; reserve rose to 288 and shield returned to 60.

Shift near Heart showed recharge but no directly established interruption benefit there. Later East Shift visibly displayed PHASE BREAK / DISCHARGE CANCELED; survived at 5 health and reached Elian recovery prompt, but died during held E.

Late unaimed firing used 11 rounds without visible additional kill before death; end screen showed 3 eliminations while earlier live counter stayed 1. I cannot establish the cause of that discrepancy.

Viewed facility map legend and held Tab trace. Walked south intake toward Mara rather than repeating initial wall detour. Recovered Mara at 00:14 versus 00:29 previously; map, visible approach and prior experience jointly helped, not isolated proof of trace efficacy.
Opening burst again killed guard. Two attempted ADS corrections at distant Sentinel spent rounds without another elimination; aim remained visibly beside target. Reload worked.

Recovered Sera directly without killing Heart guard. East guidance and marker helped orientation but maintenance objects and walls still caused overshooting; backward correction recovered Elian at 00:39.
Reached Custodian phase. Read three coils 100%, armored shutters/open-window changes, locking-lanes warning, and upload brief-pause/reenter-before-decay text. Upload was never reached.

Used crouch hint once, but no demonstrated damage reduction. Vault cleared low obstruction and distance dropped from 20 m to 12 m. Hall-opening/Tab instruction was noticed and used while flanking; eventually obtained clear view of coils at 9 m.
Initial coil burst was visibly left of coils and all three remained 100%. Tried reload and corrected aim; died during that batch, so no observed successful coil damage, shutdown, or extraction.

strengths: Cohesive teal/amber storm presentation, reflective ground and readable large title/end panels.
Recovery feedback and supplies restoration gave observable benefits; explicit outside-reach prompt enabled a successful small correction.
Combat, memory objectives and later Custodian phase create more structure than an empty shooting arena.
obstructions_and_corrections: Objective markers repeatedly pointed through opaque storage/walls. More prominent entry-side affordances and clearer nearby approach indication would reduce circling.
Small monospaced hints compete with HUD, minimap and scene signs. Increase key tactical hint size/contrast and reduce simultaneous instructional clutter.

ADS aiming and sight alignment were difficult in this screenshot-driven fallback; several long bursts visibly missed. Stronger hit confirmation and clearer coil target feedback would help distinguish cover misses from armored hits.

Death at Custodian came quickly while focusing on reload/aim despite 79 health just before. Threat direction cues existed, but a clearer lane attack countdown and attack source could help prioritize evasive action.
Live versus terminal eliminations differed in attempt 1; verify that summaries count the same category or label categories explicitly.
guidance_not_established: Saw interceptor change-direction instruction but did not deliberately time a direction change after charge; no demonstrated benefit.
Saw crouch/low-cover prompt and used crouch briefly; no demonstrated protection benefit.
Read upload decay instruction only; never reached upload or decay interaction.
limitations: Paused synthetic screenshot play with software WebGL; does not establish human enjoyment, audio quality, hardware performance, or AAA certification. These are honest limited-sample ratings, not perfection claims.
